reviews.title: HP Omni 17”
reviews.body: The best laptop I have owned.the screen is clear and crisp.  I bought the one with 2 TB and 64 ram, runs several windows at once along with applications.  Never gets loud like my Lenovo used too.  I am never having to wait for it to load, it’s super fast and reliable.
reviews.excerpt: Never gets loud like my Lenovo used too.
